body:
✏️ I think we should remove `(repeatable)`. Cobra will automatically include a type hint in the value doc to indicate repeatability. In this case it'll show:

```
--field stringArray     Name of a field to show as an extra column
```

Note `stringArray`.

Now, there's historically been the occasional confusion regarding flag repeatability, but I don't think we should introduce a new help doc pattern here. 

The established way to handle this is to add more examples of the repeatable flags to the `Example` block - I think we should definitely do that and remove `(repeatable)` in this PR 🙂

✏️ could this file please be merged with the base `queries.go`. I think it goes against cli/cli convention to have such a small file here, but doubly so since it's receiver is defined in `queries.go`. I'd prefer we move this closer to the `ID()` method on the same type.

body: 💭 I don't know if newlines are supported from the backend here, but I think this may cause some garbled output in the table if it does.

💭 Thinking about this more. I'd be fine if we migrated the existing fields-related types and methods to a `fields.go`.

I realize that's a big migration for this PR, so no pressure, but I do think that might be the "right" organization if squashing into the monolithic `queries.go` feels wrong too. 🤔

In the ambiguous-name case, the candidate field IDs are returned in the API/iteration order, which makes the error message non-deterministic and less user-friendly compared to the other error paths that sort candidates. Consider sorting the IDs before returning the FieldAmbiguousError for consistent output.

`ProjectItems` only requests the first 100 project fields (firstFields=LimitMax) and does not paginate the fields connection. For projects with >100 fields, `--field/--field-id` resolution here can incorrectly fail (and candidate lists will be incomplete) even though the field exists on later pages. Consider detecting `project.Fields.PageInfo.HasNextPage` (or `TotalCount > len(Nodes)`) when extra columns are requested and fetching the full field list before resolving.
